\---

applyTo: "client/\*\*, src/\*\*"

\---



\## Frontend instructions

\- Stack is Vue 3 + Vuetify 3

\- Prefer composables and focused components over growing large view files further

\- Avoid rewriting large views wholesale

\- Keep API integration changes explicit

\- Reuse existing UI patterns where possible

\- For revision/evidence UI, separate state management from presentation
